top_signals.title: Nike shares tumble after weak revenue outlook and layoff plans underway
top_signals.summary: Nike's shares dropped for a second straight day of declines after it reported falling revenue and plans to lay off staff.

top_signals.title: Nordic Business Group Mulls Expanding Into Critical Minerals
top_signals.summary: Nordic Compass, a competitiveness-focused business alliance, is considering branching out into critical raw materials to build up the region’s capacity to process minerals needed by European industry.
